scope: G6 optional native BC uploads; full native benchmark, reference-image and performance gates remain open.
behavior: Grant BC only from an acquired GPUDevice whose enabled features contain texture-compression-bc; adapter support alone is insufficient. Hello remains lazy for 2D-only guests; reset/loss revoke cached optional capabilities.

Identity AAE4 crossbar, linear BC1/2/3 textures retain original checked encoded bytes through DXT1/3/5 uploads. Missing host support, other crossbars, forced-opaque alpha and gamma use the established CPU RGBA conversion.

Every use retains DMA bounds, exact source-byte comparisons and PTE revalidation. Source and result sharing are counted once. GPU byte accounting includes block-rounded mip tails and all cube faces; NPOT base dimensions count the executor RGBA expansion.
Partial uploads preserve complete BC block rows with texel-space y/height. Native BC upload counters report actual payload bytes; no driver clocks or watchdog behavior changes.
